gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Alumni Sans SC sits tight and compact, its lowercase oversized beside the capitals, under a Metamorphous heading with generous sidebearings. Long paragraphs in this sans would feel compact and contemporary.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-arsenal: Arsenal reads tight and approachable, its x-height nearly matching the capitals. Beneath Metamorphous, with its high midline and soft stroke shifts, it stays plain sans text and lets the heading do the talking.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-arsenal-sc: Clean and tight, Arsenal SC sits under a Metamorphous heading. Metamorphous does best at commanding attention with that high midline, while Arsenal SC does best at fitting sans-serif characters tightly together.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-asimovian: Metamorphous carries a high midline and a brushed-watercolor hush in its line weight. Asimovian, a sans of tall-bodied lowercase and uniform strokes, sits underneath as the approachable partner that lets that heading stand out.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-courier-prime: Generous sidebearings and a high midline give Metamorphous its commanding look, set against the drafting-pen steadiness of Courier Prime, a monospace. Metamorphous earns its keep when it is big and brief.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-epunda-sans: Metamorphous spreads out with large sidebearings and a high midline, while Epunda Sans stays plain sans with trimmed spacing. The spacing difference, loose above and tight below, is what stands out.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-geist-mono: Commanding up top, strictly gridded below, with Metamorphous over Geist Mono. Long text in this monospace would march along in fixed-width steps, each lowercase letter rising high and keeping wide gaps on either side.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-genos: Contemporary and tightly packed, Genos sits beneath Metamorphous with its glyphs nearly touching. And over a long run of reading, this plain sans never snags on a closed-up bowl.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-hammersmith-one: Hammersmith One draws rounded strokes like cut lengths of cord, with capitals barely taller than lowercase. Hammersmith One against Metamorphous is mostly a story of constant width versus softly shifting strokes.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-inder: Clean and level, Inder shows little height difference between its capitals and lowercase. Metamorphous adds medium contrast without sharp hairlines, so the heading leads and this plain sans follows along.
